title: DaVita Center Updates During Hurricane Isaias
summary: During Tropical Storm Isaias, check whether your DaVita center is affected so you can plan for your kidney care needs.
body_markdown:
As Hurricane Isaias affects the U.S. Gulf Coast, the safety of our patients and teammates remains our priority.


DaVita’s care teams across the region are working diligently to help keep patients, themselves and their families safe. While the situation changes regularly, updates on how DaVita centers have been affected by the storm will be shared here.


For the latest information, please call DaVita Guest Services at **1-800-400-8331** .


**Dial 911 if you need urgent medical care or emergency assistance.**
